questions.solution:
Convert letters to their alphabetical positions and apply +13, -13 alternately.

GREAT → TERNG

G (7) + 13 = T (20)

R (18) – 13 = E (5)

E (5) +13 = R (18)

A (1) -13 = N (14)

T (20) +13 = G (7)

Apply Same to WRONG:

W(23) + 13 = J (10)

R ( 18) -13 = E (5)

O (15) + 13 = B (2)

N (14) -13 = A (1)

G (7) +13 = T (20)

Hence, JEBAT is the correct answer.

अक्षरों को उनके वर्णमाला क्रम में बदलें और बारी-बारी से +13, -13 लागू करें।
GREAT → TERNG
G (7) + 13 = T (20)
R (18) – 13 = E (5)
E (5) +13 = R (18)
A (1) -13 = N (14)
T (20) +13 = G (7)

यही नियम WRONG पर लागू करने पर:
W(23) + 13 = J (10)
R (18) -13 = E (5)
O (15) + 13 = B (2)
N (14) -13 = A (1)
G (7) +13 = T (20)

अतः, JEBAT सही उत्तर है।
